keys.name: settlement.batch-size
keys.doc: Instructions settled per transaction; a failing batch rolls back alone

keys.name: settlement.failure-prefix
keys.doc: POC hook: an instruction whose reference starts with this prefix fails unexpectedly, to show batch isolation

keys.name: settlement.interval
keys.doc: Interval of the settlement timer (Quartz, one execution per interval across the cluster)

keys.name: settlement.max-instruction-amount
keys.doc: Instructions above this amount are rejected, not settled; the platform sets it per environment

keys.name: quarkus.flyway.migrate-at-start
keys.doc: Run the migrations of the release at start-up (false where the DBA applies them)

keys.name: quarkus.datasource.jdbc.url
keys.doc: JDBC URL of the application database (Agroal pool)

keys.name: quarkus.datasource.password
keys.doc: Database password, delivered from the vault

keys.name: quarkus.datasource.jdbc.max-size
keys.doc: Upper bound of the connection pool

keys.name: quarkus.transaction-manager.node-name
keys.doc: XA recovery node name: unique per instance (EAP: the server name)

keys.name: quarkus.transaction-manager.object-store.directory
keys.doc: XA transaction log: persistent, node-local, outside the release directory (EAP: standalone/data/tx-object-store)

keys.name: quarkus.http.port
keys.doc: API port, the load balancer target

keys.name: quarkus.quartz.clustered
keys.doc: Quartz cluster mode: true whenever more than one instance runs

keys.name: quarkus.scheduler.enabled
keys.doc: Switch off the scheduler on instances that must not run jobs (e.g. a read-only replica)
